item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nail
  • 発売日: 2005-07-29
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: As you like～星降る夜にロマンスを～
  • 英語名: As you like Hoshi Furu Yoru ni Romance o

别名

  • As you like An Starry Night Romance

あらすじ

Our protagonist Ninomiya Daigo attends Aoba Academy, where his childhood friend Kana was recently appointed as the new English teacher after finishing university in another city. However, Kana moves to Daigo’s house to some reason and she’s completely unable to do any housework, so it’s up to Daigo to take care of her! However, Daigo does his best in order to make her fall with him and answer his confession in the next Tanabata festival.

item.title: 3-days Marriage ~Hikaru Genji no Koibito~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nail
  • 発売日: 2004-04-30
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 3-days Marriage ～光源氏の恋人～
  • 英語名: 3-days Marriage Hikaru Genji no Koibito

あらすじ

Sumeragi Kouichi is heir to a lineage historically known to produce prestigious statesmen. In spite of this, he has remained outside the political spectrum, enjoying life as a normal high school student. Yet destiny has other plans for Kouichi, and his world is drastically challenged when its revealed he is to marry the daughter of a wealthy businessman: a girl who also happens to be his best friend’s younger sister. Can Kouichi find true love in something devoid of freewill; or is this marriage of convenience doomed to fail?
